arc.mood: Day one ran past midnight. First drink was wine, forty-six seconds of it. First words were a whisper, to a stranger who watched him miss a wolf three times. Found Ironforge. Found a quest about missing blasting powder and kept his face still.
arc.lookingFor: Someone who stays. Says it's a business partner for a brewery. It isn't.
runningBits: The malt he still hasn't opened; the wine didn't count
The staff he forgot he owned
arc.wanted: WANTED: partner for a brewery that doesn't exist yet. Must tolerate noise, smoke, and questions about where you're from. Must laugh when I miss a wolf with a staff, but kindly. Dwarves need not apply, probably; the valley's full of them and not one asked. Inquire at Thunderbrew Distillery, loudest table.
arc.beat: Dagnar was logged in this morning with the addon still disabled and the chat log unmoved since Wednesday. Turn both on first. Then it is four days since anyone heard him: open the malt, and ask one gnome what Gnomeregan smelled like.
arc.storySoFar:
Dagnar Barleigh was a Dark Iron demolitions engineer who walked away from a job in Loch Modan and never said why. He drifted to the Wildhammer in the Hinterlands, where an old shaman taught him to hold the fire in him instead of being held by it. He took a new name, learned to heal fast and ugly, and kept his engineering, which exploded past the fourth pint. He called the missing eyebrows quality control and said he wanted a partner for a brewery. It was not a brewery.

On the fourth of November 2026 he stepped into Coldridge Valley and found it wall to wall with dwarves and gnomes. He sat at a campfire with three dwarves, reached level six before his first drink, and said yes when a human named Malachi Zerbe pulled him into The Brave of Lordaeron. He died three times, unbothered. His first drink was a bottle of Dalaran Noir, which he insisted did not count. He missed a wolf three times with a staff he had forgotten he owned, and a stranger called Lime Rickey laughed, kindly. He reached Ironforge after eleven, piped rats in the Tram, and ended the night in Gol'Bolar Quarry with a quest about stolen blasting powder and a very still face. Then the record went dark.

Emmitt Brown.lastSaid: Congratulated a gnome on being named Pongo.
Emmitt Brown.note: Gnome. Thinks everyone is tall. Danced at the doors. I like him already.

Frizzle Cinderspark.lastSaid: Suggested everyone was short, not tall.
Frizzle Cinderspark.note: Gnome. Called the valley a family reunion. Asked after a Christmas card.

Fodrin Firebrand.note: Dwarf. Danced before he'd finished cheering.

Bargash Greybeard.lastSaid: Admired the pile of corpses, loudly, for the king.
Bargash Greybeard.note: Dwarf. Shouts for the forge and king. Likes a corpse pile.

Brother Borelgore.note: Dwarf. Looking for Phil. I hope he finds Phil.

Igneous Stonegarden.note: Dwarf. Says hello to everyone. Congratulates strangers.

Griym Firebeard.lastSaid: Called the wolf business the food chain.
Griym Firebeard.note: Dwarf. Has a theory about the food chain.

Doldrenn Stoneforge.note: Dwarf. Will join anyone for wolves. My kind of recruit.

Pus Pus.lastSaid: The shop was down, with feeling.
Pus Pus.note: Gnome. Tells jokes to other gnomes. Reports outages.

Anthéor Stonehymn.lastSaid: Declined to log out for the quest reward.
Anthéor Stonehymn.note: Dwarf. Knows what being a dwarf is about. Waited on a fire that owed him.

Embertempest Anvilmar.lastSaid: The campfire quest wouldn't pay out.
Embertempest Anvilmar.note: Dwarf. Smiled at a campfire that owed them a reward.

Náin Snowholdt.lastSaid: Suggested logging out and back in, out of character.
Náin Snowholdt.note: Dwarf. Wanted wolves early. Gives practical advice to strangers.

posts.title: Launch day
posts.text: Doors opened early. Coldridge Valley is wall-to-wall dwarves and gnomes, all shouting. Nothing's exploded yet. Give it a week.
posts.detail: Couldn't swing a dead cat without hitting a dwarf. Somebody else said that first.

posts.title: Coldridge, wall to wall
posts.text: Coldridge Valley, wall to wall, every dwarf and gnome on the realm shouting at once. I stood in it and asked nobody anything.
posts.detail: A gnome called Emmitt found everyone tall. Another, Frizzle, called it a family reunion. A dwarf named Doldrenn went off wolf-killing with a Náin. Nobody asked where I'm from. Nobody will, in a valley this full of dwarves.
posts.alt: Coldridge Valley on launch night, seen through three setup windows that would not close.

posts.title: Two to six
posts.text: Level six before the first pint. Wolves, troggs, a troll cave, two mail runs. Picked up skinning and mining because the mountain was offering.
posts.detail: The mornbrew went cold on the first delivery and had to go again. The earth sapta wouldn't turn in, twice. I was already carrying one. An engineer's mistake, not a shaman's.
posts.alt: Level six, in the snow, with a wolf and two troggs waiting their turn.

posts.title: The campfire
posts.text: Sat by Eric Brighthammer's fire with three dwarves. Anthéor Stonehymn said this was the whole point of being a dwarf. He's not wrong.
posts.detail: The fire paid me and wouldn't pay them. Embertempest Anvilmar and Anthéor were still waiting when I stood up. Náin Snowholdt suggested leaving and coming back. Anthéor declined.

posts.title: A guild, apparently
posts.text: Set my hearth at Thunderbrew Distillery, which tells you my priorities. Six minutes on, a human called Malachi Zerbe asked me into The Brave of Lordaeron. Said yes.
posts.detail: Hadn't said a word all night and still got invited. Either a good sign about them or a bad one about the night. The hall was loud within the minute. Humans, mostly, from the sound of it.

posts.title: Died once, so far
posts.text: Cheered for a lost gnome at fourteen past. Dead by fifteen past. Unrelated, as far as the gnome knows.
posts.detail: Ten percent off the gear. Walked back, finished Flintfire's shipment, then learned to cook boar ribs in beer, which is the first sensible thing anyone's taught me here.

posts.title: Camp cooking
posts.text: Charred the wolf, roasted the boar, got cooking up to five without burning anything that mattered. Then learned to roll a linen bandage. For other people, mostly.
posts.detail: No pint yet. The malt stays shut. The pilots at Steelgrill's wanted wendigo manes next, so that's where the evening went.

posts.title: The Grizzled Den
posts.text: Two dozen wendigo in one cave and I skinned most of them. One of their shamans objected at eight minutes to nine. Ten percent off the gear, again.
posts.detail: Died holding a carpenter's mallet I'd picked up six seconds earlier. Walked back. The cave was quiet by nine and skinning sat at seventy.

posts.title: Brewnall Village
posts.text: Walked into Brewnall Village on the lake and a Barleybrew handed me a barrel of Scalder to carry to his rival. No relation. A brewery, though. A real one.
posts.detail: Chill Breeze Valley first, then the lake, then Gnomeregan's front door for scale. Kharanos taught me a stoneclaw and a lightning shield on the way. Still nothing to drink. The Scalder is not mine to open.

posts.title: Gnomeregan's doorstep
posts.text: Leper gnomes at the front door of Gnomeregan, eighteen of them, every one promising to cut me. Took their cogs and gears instead. Razzle wants them for a machine.
posts.detail: Then up to Frostmane Hold, which is trolls, and a few leopards and bears on the way that nobody asked for. Rolled five bandages at two minutes to ten. Used none, which is the trick.

posts.title: The Recombobulator
posts.text: Died a third time at six past ten, to a troll at Frostmane Hold, which is what trolls are for. Three minutes later Razzle Sprysprocket fired up the Recombobulator with my gears.
posts.detail: It was meant to save the entire gnomish race. It needed more grease. Got driving gloves for the trouble and a short staff from Bellowfiz for walking back. Someone in Kharanos wants me to meet a visitor. Tomorrow. The malt's still shut.

posts.title: First night
posts.text: First night and I didn't say a word out loud. Twelve people talked near me and I listened, which you'd call progress and I'd call the cold.
posts.detail: Nobody asked where I'm from. Nobody will, in a valley this full of dwarves. Set my hearth at a distillery, joined a guild of humans with a brave name, died three times in the snow and minded the walks more. The malt they gave me for a delivery is still in the pack. Haven't decided who to open it with.

posts.title: The forgotten staff
posts.text: Swung a staff at a winter wolf and missed three times running. I'd forgotten I owned it. Someone called Lime Rickey saw the whole thing and laughed, kindly.
posts.detail: First words I've put to anyone here, and they were an excuse. Lime said stay safe, friend. Whispered, not said out loud, so the letter stands.

posts.title: Dalaran Noir
posts.text: First drink on the record. Carried a barrel of Shimmer Stout up Shimmer Ridge past the Frostmane, and the reward was a bottle of Dalaran Noir. Wine. From a bottle.
posts.detail: Tipsy for forty-six seconds, sober by quarter to. The Thunderbrews know what I am and handed me grapes anyway. The malt stays shut; this didn't count.

posts.title: Finding Warmth
posts.text: Watched Jarven Thunderbrew's barrels twice while he drank inside. Then north to the Tundrid Hills for quests called Finding Warmth, Treacherous Cold and Rime's Wrath.
posts.detail: A shaman sent to find warmth. I've been on that errand a while. Came away with a small bird that whistles, two linen bags and a binding called Avala's. Rime's Wrath twice, because once wasn't enough for someone.

posts.title: Ironforge
posts.text: Through the Gates of Ironforge at twenty past eleven. The great forge, a woman selling bread baked that morning, and a trade channel complaining the city was empty.
posts.detail: Learned to build a camp chair, the first thing I've been taught here that I'd actually sit in. The spirits also left word: a Call of Fire. We're acquainted. I'll go when I'm sober enough to be polite about it.

posts.title: Rats in the Tram
posts.text: Under the city a dwarf called Monty handed me a flute and a box and said the rats would walk in one by one. They did. Nine hundred points of experience for piping vermin.
posts.detail: Also took a carton of mystery meat for a man's brother Nipsy and asked no questions, because I've carried worse for less. The Deeprun Tram hums like a still about to go.

posts.title: Gol'Bolar Quarry
posts.text: Amberstill Ranch, where a girl was chasing a ram named Fluffy, then Gol'Bolar Quarry till past midnight. Rockjaw troggs. One word each. Mostly Destroy.
posts.detail: Someone there has lost blasting powder and wants it found. I said nothing. I'm the only dwarf in the quarry who knows what it's for, and it would be rude to look pleased. Mining up to seven. Bed at eleven past.

recipes.note: Charred is the recipe, not the result.
